$comment: Production (npm audit --omit=dev) HIGH advisories that are KNOWN and consciously deferred. The CI gate FAILS on any prod high NOT listed here (and on ANY prod critical, which is never allowlistable), so a NEW vulnerability blocks merge while these tracked ones do not. When you upgrade a dependency, delete its cleared entries (the gate warns about stale entries). Every entry needs a category + the reason it is deferred; impact is the advisory `title`.

allow.title: image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
allow.note: DIRECT apps/api dependency: image-size sizes USER-UPLOADED images at request time (media.service.ts), so the parser infinite-loop DoS is reachable at runtime, not only at build time. Kept ONLY because there is no patched upstream version (fixAvailable=false); mitigate by gating size/type before sizeOf.
